title: You Thought China Held America's Debt?
hook: Every country owes money. Almost nobody asks who holds it.
question: Did you assume China?
note: Myth-break. Figures pulled from EP011: Japan ~$1.1T (#1 foreign holder of U.S. debt), China under $1T and selling, the Fed held over $5T. Most sovereign debt is owed domestically. Every beat has a literal animated doodle.

scenes.narration: Every country on Earth owes money. Almost nobody stops to ask who is actually holding it.
Most people picture China, holding America's debt across the ocean.
scenes.sub: China → bankrolling America across the ocean

scenes.narration: But most government debt is not owed abroad at all. It is owed at home, to a country's own central bank, its own banks, and its own pension funds.
scenes.sub: a country's own central bank, banks and pensions

scenes.narration: Even the biggest foreign holder of U.S. debt is not China. It is Japan, about one point one trillion dollars.
scenes.kicker: Biggest FOREIGN holder of U.S. debt
scenes.label: Japan — not China

scenes.narration: China sits under a trillion, and it has been selling for years.
scenes.label: and selling for years

scenes.narration: The single biggest holder of all? America's own Federal Reserve, over five trillion dollars. The bank that prints the money, lending it right back to the government.

rows.name: The Fed
rows.note: prints the dollars, lends them back

scenes.narration: So. Did you assume it was China?
scenes.sub: Comment what surprised you — full story in the video
